Simulate the ORION-10 trial

Source: R/orion10.R
simulate_orion10.Rd

Returns simulated, analysis-ready LDL cholesterol data modelled on ORION-10, a trial of inclisiran against placebo (NCT03399370). Every subject is made up. The data has one row per subject per scheduled visit, with no missing values, ready for the trial's mixed model for repeated measures (MMRM).

Usage

simulate_orion10(n)

Arguments

n

Number of subjects, at least 2. Subjects are randomized 1:1; when n is odd, the extra subject gets inclisiran. ORION-10 randomized 1,561.

Value

A tibble with one row per subject per visit, sorted by subject and then visit. Columns that aren't numeric are factors:

  • subject_id: Subject identifier, such as "001-0001".

  • treatment: "Placebo" or "Inclisiran", with placebo as the reference level.

  • age: Age in years.

  • sex: "Female" or "Male".

  • race: "Black", "Other" or "White".

  • visit: Ordered factor, "Day 150" to "Day 540". LDL was also measured on Day 90, but the trial's analysis plan leaves it out of the model.

  • day: Study day of the visit.

  • ldl_baseline: LDL at baseline, in mg/dL.

  • ldl: LDL at the visit, in mg/dL.

  • ldl_pct_change: Percent change in LDL from baseline.

Details

The baseline LDL, the mean percent change at each visit and the demographics follow the trial's published results. The mean percent changes follow the observed means, not the published estimates that account for missing values, so the treatment effect is a few points larger than the published one. vignette("orion10", package = "clinique") explains each number, its source and the assumptions.

The data is simulated. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the trial's sponsor.

Reproducibility

Call set.seed() first to get the same data each time. The same seed gives the same data on every operating system. The correlated values at each visit are drawn with base R's chol(), which returns the one upper-triangular Cholesky factor of the covariance matrix. Methods based on eigen(), such as MASS::mvrnorm(), can return different factors on different systems, and so different data for the same seed.

References

Statistical analysis plan: https://cdn.clinicaltrials.gov/large-docs/70/NCT03399370/SAP_001.pdf

FDA statistical review: https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/nda/2022/214012Orig1s000StatR.pdf

Ray KK, et al. Two Phase 3 Trials of Inclisiran in Patients with Elevated LDL Cholesterol. N Engl J Med 2020;382:1507-1519. doi:10.1056/NEJMoa1912387

Examples

set.seed(1)
orion10 <- simulate_orion10(100)
head(orion10)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 10
#>   subject_id treatment   age sex   race  visit   day ldl_baseline   ldl
#>   <fct>      <fct>     <dbl> <fct> <fct> <ord> <dbl>        <dbl> <dbl>

#> 4 001-0001   Placebo      70 Fema… White Day …   450         89.6  78.6
